title: Verify: transitionTo unsubscribe on shutdown unit tests
summary: Unit tests that transitionTo is ignored after SHUTDOWN and other subscribers stay active
description: Add a test file modelled on bootScenePlayAnimationShutdown.test.ts asserting no fade after shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: No fadeOut after the SHUTDOWN callback
Pre-registered transitionTo subscriber still receives events

steps.action: Create the file with the same mocks as bootSceneTransitionTo.test.ts. In beforeEach subscribe otherHandler via reactToPhaser.on('transitionTo') then boot.create(). Test 1: run the shutdown callback found in events.once mock calls, clear fadeOut mock, emit transitionTo { sceneId: 'library' }, assert fadeOut not called. Test 2: after shutdown, emit and assert otherHandler toHaveBeenCalledWith({ sceneId: 'library' }).
